name: Apple
desc: A common fruit found throughout Hyrule. Eat raw or cook.

name: Hydromelon
desc: A water-rich melon. Great for heat resistance dishes.

name: Spicy Pepper
desc: A hot pepper that grants cold resistance when cooked.

name: Mighty Banana
desc: A tropical fruit that boosts attack power.

name: Diamond
desc: A precious gemstone. Sells for a high price.

name: Star Fragment
desc: A fragment of a fallen star. Extremely rare and valuable.

name: Ancient Core
desc: A component from Guardians. Used at Kochi Dye Shop and Akkala Lab.

name: Luminous Stone
desc: A glowing ore found in caves. Trade for diamonds at Zora's Domain.

name: Fireproof Elixir
desc: An elixir that grants heat resistance for a time.

name: Monster Extract
desc: A dubious ingredient. Cooking results are unpredictable.
